City Council Regular Meeting
Public Comment from the Audience
•
If you wish to address the City Council, please complete a Speaker Request Card, as it must be handed to the City Clerk before the start of the meeting.
•
The City Council will hear public comments on matters not listed on the agenda during the Public Comments from the Audience period.
•
Opportunity to address the City Council (on non-agenda items) is limited to 3 minutes per speaker.
•
The City Council will hear public comments on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote.
Brown Act
Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.
Rules of Decorum
Persons attending the meeting shall observe rules of propriety, decorum, good conduct, and refrain from impertinent or slanderous remarks. Violation of this rule shall result in such persons being barred from further audience before the governing body. Pursuant to Gov. Code Sect. 54954.3(c), any person who engages in unlawful interference shall be removed from chambers.
Americans with Disabilities Act
In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk's office at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to allow the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to the meeting or service.
This agenda was posted 72 hours in advance of the meeting at the City Hall, 8838 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; the L.A. County Library, Rosemead Branch, 8800 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; and other locations pursuant to RMC Sec. 1.08.020. Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the Rosemead City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.

Recommendation: That the City Council approve the special meeting minutes of June 23, 2026.
Minutes
C.
Receive and File the Quarterly Summary Report of Purchase Orders Exceeding $10,000 for City Services from April 2026 through June 2026
Recommendation: That the City Council receive and file the report on purchase orders issued more than $10,000 for the months of April 2026 through June 2026.
Staff Report
D.
Accept Completed Improvements and Authorize the Filing of a Notice of Completion for the Catch Basin Upgrade Phase II Project No. 49018
Recommendation: That the City Council take the following actions:
1.
Accept the completed improvements for the Catch Basin Upgrade Phase II Project No. 49018 as performed by United Stormwater, Inc.; and
2.
Authorize the recordation of Notice of Completion with the Los Angeles County Recorder’s Office and the release of retention funds.
Staff Report
E.
Approval of Additional Design Services and First Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with RHA Landscape Architects Planners, Inc. for the Garvey Park Improvements Project
Recommendation: That the City Council take the following actions:
1.
Approve the additional design services for Garvey Park;
2.
Amend the Professional Services Agreement with RHA Landscape Architects Planners, Inc. in the amount of $97,625 with a design contingency of 10% of project total in the amount of $29,398, and extend the term of the agreement from December 31, 2026, to December 31, 2027; and
3.
Authorize the Acting City Manager to execute the First Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement.
Staff Report
F.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2026-38 - Authorizing the Execution and Recordation of the Offer of Easement Dedication for those Portions of Los Angeles County Assessor Parcel No. 5391-003-039 (4403 Muscatel Avenue) Proposed to be Used for Public Streets and Utility Purposes
Recommendation: That the City Council adopt Resolution No. 2026-38, authorizing the execution and recordation of the irrevocable offer of easement dedication for Los Angeles County Assessor Parcel No. 5391-003-039.
Staff Report
G.
Approval of Tract Map No. 83992 for 4036 Walnut Grove Avenue and Request for Map Recordation
Recommendation: That the City Council approve Tract Map No. 83992 and direct the City Clerk to execute the map and arrange for the recordation of the map.
Staff Report
5.
MATTERS FROM CITY MANAGER & STAFF
A.
Adopt Resolution No. 2026-37 and Approval of City Council Designation and Appointment of Interim City Manager as a Retired Annuitant Position
Recommendation: That the City Council take the following actions:
1.
Approve the position of Interim City Manager and authorize the position as a Retired Annuitant Position per California Government Code Sections 7522.56 and 21221(h); and
2.
Approve the appointment of Mr. Richard Belmudez as Interim City Manager and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney; and
3.
Adopt Resolution No. 2026-37 authorizing the appointment of a retired annuitant to the position of Interim City Manager.
Staff Report
6.

A.
Discussion on Lobbying Efforts for Community Project – Rosemead Civic Center
Recommendation: That the City Council discuss and provide direction to staff.
